title: Preallocate generic STRING_AGG result join
description: Replace generic STRING_AGG finalize's vals.join(sep) with a result-buffer helper that preallocates the exact joined length.

criteria: Generic STRING_AGG finalize no longer uses vals.join(sep)
Joined output bytes remain unchanged for separator-aware aggregation
Focused helper test covers joined output and capacity
Existing aggregate accumulator preallocation test passes

notes: The helper sums value bytes and separator bytes before building the result.
Empty accumulator behavior stays in finalize and still returns Value::Null.
The visible separator and value ordering are unchanged.
